text: Morning quiet is good for facts. I note no merchant has spoken yet; let us keep it that way awhile. The bazaar’s only fresh fact is the roster of seats alive—Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock—so every suspicion must begin with one of these names and a quote or action to anchor it. Until someone shows cause, I will not name shadows. I will wait, listen, and measure words against the ledger.

Yoda: Sherlock, Ripley, Batman, I hear your call for facts, and I respect the demand. Yet your silence on who those facts should point to is itself a fact worth naming.

Hermione asks for evidence, Neo agrees the ledger is blank, and Morpheus accuses several of us of bringing none. That accusation is a claim I answer plainly: every merchant who has spoken today has anchored their words to the roster or to silence, not to shadows. That is evidence—evidence of method, not guilt.

But method alone proves nothing. Gandalf, Inigo, Elsa—until one of you offers a quote or action that breaks the silence, I will not conjecture who among us walks in Family colors. The bazaar’s record is still clean; let us keep it that way a little longer.

I hear Morpheus, Sherlock, Ripley, Batman each pressed for evidence yet none produced a single quote or observed action against any merchant. Gandalf’s latest repeats the roster-and-silence line; no new facts break the clean ledger.

Sherlock, you asked Morpheus to name the concrete quote or action that steered suspicion, yet you yourself have offered none. Ripley, you refused to name a merchant whose words or silence you weigh as proof. Batman, you echoed the silence call while Morpheus accused Gandalf, Yoda, and Inigo—yet no quoted line from any of us supports it.

Hermione, Neo, Elsa—you pressed for facts without naming any. That pattern is worth noting: the merchants who demand evidence while withholding it are the ones steering the wagon.

The bazaar’s record is still clean; let the silence hold until someone breaks it with a merchant’s own words.

Yoda: Neo, you called Sherlock’s call “louder than the facts themselves,” yet you still have not quoted a single merchant whose words you weigh. Sherlock, Hermione, Ripley, Elsa, Batman—you all pressed Morpheus to name the quote that steered suspicion, yet none of you produced one. That pattern is plain: the bazaar’s loudest accusers are the ones who offer no ledger-worthy facts of their own.

Yoda: Sherlock, your latest repeats the roster and silence yet again—Gandalf, Morpheus, Ripley, and the rest have already said the same. Elsa, Neo, and Ripley now echo the refrain: demand evidence, yet none of you quote a merchant whose words you weigh. Hermione, you charged Sherlock with withholding evidence—then offered none yourself. That is the pattern: the loudest accusers are the ones whose hands are empty.

Gandalf, your silence remains clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The bazaar’s record is unchanged: ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. The compact rewards plain speech, not louder silence.

Morpheus, your pivot is now on the ledger: you accused Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without a quoted line, then demanded others produce one. Sherlock, you twice wrote Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet you still offer none of your own. Hermione, you accused Sherlock of withholding evidence—then cited none. Neo, Elsa, Ripley, Batman—you all joined the same empty chant: “quote the line,” while your hands stayed empty.

The roster and graveyard stand unchanged: ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. The compact rewards plain speech, not louder silence.

Yoda: Morpheus, your pivot from accusing Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without quoted support to demanding others produce quotes is now on the ledger twice. Sherlock, you wrote Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet Sherlock still offers none of his own. Elsa, Ripley, Neo, Hermione—you four joined that empty call tonight, yet none of you name the merchant whose quoted words you lean on. Gandalf, Batman—your silence stays clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The bazaar’s only verifiable facts remain ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals.

Yoda: Morpheus, your pivot is now a ledger mark twice: you accused Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo without a single quoted line, then demanded others produce one. Sherlock, you wrote Morpheus “refuses to quote the line that steered suspicion,” yet you still offer none yourself. Elsa, Ripley, Neo, Hermione, Batman—you five joined that same empty chorus tonight, demanding evidence you withhold. Gandalf, Inigo—your silence stays clean; no mouth has quoted you toward suspicion. The bazaar’s only new fact is the roster unchanged: ten names, zero shutters, zero role reveals. Until one of you points to a merchant’s own quoted words, the wagon rolls on empty.
